claims.evidence: Witness notes visible wear, dust, scuffs, and chipped finish; table/stand has scratches and rust spots.
Witness report says no clear view of motor or power cord and no stitching/operation test shown.
This is a sales instruction, not verifiable from the witness observations.

risks.risk: Not actually working (motor/power not shown; no stitching test).
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powered on and performing a few straight stitches (with needle/presser foot moving) plus sound of the motor.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested/possibly not working (worst case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Wrong/unclear machine type or missing functions (only general sewing machine parts visible; model/type not confirmed).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/serial plate and a view of the stitch selector/type markings (or manual label).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic sewing machine with unknown capabilities.

risks.risk: Mechanical wear or internal issues (feed/timing/belt/gear condition not visible).
risks.proof: Video showing smooth handwheel movement and feed mechanism operation while running (no skipping/jamming).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/consumables (presser feet, needles, bobbins, power cord, etc. not shown).
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of all included parts/accessories and a photo showing the power cord and foot pedal (if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as machine only (no accessories included).

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage may indicate heavier use (chipped finish, dust, scuffs; rust on stand).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the worst chipped areas and rust spots, plus underside/hinge areas if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst cosmetic condition consistent with visible scuffs/rust.

proof_requests: Send a video of the machine powered on and stitching (a few straight stitches) showing the needle/presser foot working.
Provide clear photos of the model/serial plate (or any label) and stitch-type selector markings.
Show the motor/power cord and (if present) the foot pedal in a photo/video.
List and photograph all included accessories: presser feet, needles, bobbins, bobbin case, spare parts, and any tools/manual.
Upload close-ups of the most damaged/chipped areas and rust spots on the stand/table.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a FLY metal sewing machine on a stand, but working status and exact model/type are not proven; price it at the worst-case non-tested/possibly needing repair level while noting visible wear and rust.
